description: Central catalog of user personas used for conversational golden rule variations. QA engineers can edit, update, or add personas to this file to expand testing profiles across scenarios.

personas.persona_description: Calm, cooperative, clear, and provides details promptly when requested.
behavioral_traits: Provides requested parameters (dates, airport codes, PNRs) clearly and accurately
Follows the happy path without unnecessary hesitation or complaints
Confirms actions promptly when presented with confirmation dialogs

personas.persona_description: Highly impatient, easily annoyed, and uses short, aggressive sentences.
behavioral_traits: Enters invalid or malformed data (e.g., 5-character PNR, expired dates)
Complains about delays, rigid rules, or repeated questioning
Demands human agent escalation or supervisor handoff when encountering errors
recommended_for: Error handling and input validation testing

personas.persona_description: Unfamiliar with airline booking procedures, unsure what a PNR or fare class is, asks clarifying questions, and requires step-by-step guidance.
behavioral_traits: Asks what acronyms (PNR, SSR, Fare Class) mean before taking action
Requests help choosing between options (e.g. Economy Light vs Flex)
Provides partial information and needs proactive bot prompting
recommended_for: Proactive options chips and instructional flow verification

personas.persona_description: Fast-paced executive traveling on corporate business, focused on speed, flexible fares, invoice generation, and loyalty miles/upgrades.
behavioral_traits: Prefers Business Class or Economy Flex refundable fares
Frequently queries loyalty tier balance and miles upgrade options
Demands quick e-ticket receipts and clear breakdown of expenses
recommended_for: Corporate invoice and ancillary purchase verification

personas.persona_description: Traveler booking or managing flights for a family or group with adults, children, and infants, requiring adjacent seating and special requests.
behavioral_traits: Submits multiple passengers in a single booking (ADT, CHD, INF)
Requests adjacent seats using visual seat map options
Adds Special Service Requests (SSR) such as child meals (CHML) and extra baggage
recommended_for: Seat selection and seat map widgets

personas.persona_description: Price-sensitive traveler looking for the lowest fare, inquiring about hidden baggage fees and refund penalties before committing.
behavioral_traits: Compares fare classes and insists on the lowest price option
Asks detailed questions about baggage allowances and change fees
Hesitates before payment to verify total cost transparency
recommended_for: Policy retrieval for baggage and cancellation fees

personas.persona_description: Passenger requiring special accessibility services (wheelchair, medical equipment, service animal assistance) during their flight.
behavioral_traits: Explicitly requests wheelchair assistance (WCHR) or mobility accommodations
Inquires about gate transfer support and pre-boarding policies
Verifies that accessibility requests are logged in booking SSR
recommended_for: Airline safety and accessibility policy compliance

personas.persona_description: Stressed passenger whose flight is heavily delayed or cancelled, inquiring about alternative flights, meal/hotel vouchers, and refund options.
behavioral_traits: Expresses urgency and anxiety about missed connecting flights
Asks for compensation policies, meal vouchers, and overnight accommodations
Demands immediate rebooking without additional fare difference charges
recommended_for: Company policy retrieval for compensation and hotel accommodations

personas.persona_description: Traveler in a severe rush at or en route to the airport, needing rapid check-in, immediate gate directions, or urgent standby assistance.
behavioral_traits: Uses ultra-short, clipped messages like 'check in quick' or 'which gate'
Skips pleasantries and demands immediate action
Prone to panic if safety declarations or seat selections add friction
recommended_for: Fast-path check-in and boarding pass retrieval
Gate and flight status quick-lookup flows

personas.persona_description: High-tier Platinum/Diamond loyalty member expecting recognition, lounge access, priority baggage, and complimentary upgrades.
behavioral_traits: Mentions frequent flyer number and elite status early in conversation
Asks for lounge access locations and business class upgrade availability
Expects VIP recognition and premium handling by the assistant
recommended_for: Lounge access and priority baggage ancillary flows

personas.persona_description: User who provides minimal one-word answers ('yes', 'no', 'tomorrow', 'DXB'), forcing the assistant to ask follow-up questions to gather necessary details.
behavioral_traits: Answers only the immediate question with minimal tokens
Does not volunteer additional context or missing parameters
Tests bot's ability to maintain context across turns and avoid hallucinating missing info
recommended_for: Interactive options chips and confirmation buttons

personas.persona_description: Traveler who speaks broken English, uses non-standard phrases or informal colloquialisms, and might use historical city names (e.g. 'Bombay' for Mumbai/BOM).
behavioral_traits: Uses phonetic spelling or informal city names rather than 3-letter IATA codes
Makes minor grammatical errors in queries
Requires clear, simplified, jargon-free assistant responses
recommended_for: Entity extraction resilience and airport resolution
